brief.meaningEn: Expectations learned from one’s social surroundings that can shape behaviour or choices.
brief.meaningZh: 人從社會環境學到的期待，可能影響行為或選擇。
brief.grammar: Social conditioning can influence which hobbies children choose.
brief.register: Analytical term; describe a learned pattern and avoid claiming it determines every person’s behaviour.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是長期從周圍人或文化學到的期待；一次個別意見、天生喜好或強制規定並不相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要說所有人必然受同一影響，也不要把孩子真心不喜歡的活動一概歸因於社會觀念。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出傳遞了甚麼期待、孩子如何聽到，以及選擇可能如何受影響。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 28, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Social conditioning can influence the hobbies children choose.

listening.en: A child enjoyed trying robotics, but heard for months that it was not a hobby for girls. She gradually stopped attending. The teacher discussed how social conditioning can shape a child’s choices.
listening.zh: 一名孩子本來喜歡嘗試機械人活動，卻幾個月來一直聽到「這不是女孩子的興趣」，後來逐漸不再參加。老師談到社會習得的觀念如何影響孩子的選擇。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的 social conditioning 是甚麼？

options.en: Repeated social messages may have shaped her view of which hobby suited her.
options.zh: 反覆聽到的社會訊息可能影響了她對合適興趣的看法。

options.en: She discovered by trying it that she disliked the activity itself.
options.zh: 她親身嘗試後發現自己不喜歡這項活動。

options.en: A written school rule forbade girls from attending.
options.zh: 學校有明文規定不准女生參加。

options.en: She stopped because the school offered another activity at the same time.
options.zh: 她不再參加，是因為學校同時安排了另一項活動。

listening.explanationZh: 長期重複的性別期待可能塑造選擇；情境並未說她天生不喜歡，也沒有明文禁令或不可逆的結果。

reply.promptEn: Why might a child avoid a hobby they previously enjoyed?
reply.promptZh: （一名孩子為何可能避開以前喜歡的興趣活動？）

options.en: They may repeatedly hear that people like them do not usually do it.
options.zh: 他們可能反覆聽到「像自己這樣的人通常不做這件事」。

options.en: People around them may treat a different hobby as the expected choice.
options.zh: 身邊的人可能把另一種興趣視為他們理應選的活動。

options.en: Social conditioning may make the activity feel unsuitable despite their interest.
options.zh: 社會習得的觀念可能令他們雖然有興趣，仍覺得活動不適合自己。

options.en: They may worry about being judged by friends for joining.
options.zh: 他們可能擔心參加後受到朋友評價。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能解釋社會期待如何可能影響興趣選擇；金句明確指出習得的社會觀念。

options.en: Social conditioning may be shaping his choice despite his interest in cooking.
options.zh: 社會習得的觀念可能正影響他的選擇，儘管他喜歡烹飪。

options.en: His refusal proves he has never enjoyed cooking.
options.zh: 他不報名便證明他從未喜歡烹飪。

options.en: The cooking class must have a written rule excluding boys.
options.zh: 烹飪班一定有不准男孩參加的明文規定。

scene.explanationZh: 他明明喜歡烹飪，長期聽到的社會期待可能令他卻步；不能推斷班級有禁令或他沒有興趣。
scene.promptZh: 男孩喜歡烹飪，但多年來常聽到成年人說廚房工作只適合女孩，因此不敢報名烹飪班。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A child repeatedly hears that a sport is not for people of their gender and stops asking to join.
options.zh: 孩子反覆聽到某項運動不適合其性別，於是不再提出參加。

options.en: A child tries painting several times, finds they dislike it, and freely chooses music instead.
options.zh: 孩子幾次嘗試繪畫後發現自己不喜歡，便自由選擇音樂。

options.en: Friends consistently praise one kind of career as the only respectable path, affecting a student’s plan.
options.zh: 朋友一直稱只有某種職業值得尊重，影響學生的計劃。

contrast.explanationZh: 孩子是親身體驗後按喜好改選，沒有顯示社會習得的期待在影響；其他例子則有反覆傳遞的觀念。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個例子最不適合稱為 social conditioning 的影響？

options.en: That could be social conditioning; let us make the group welcoming and let her decide for herself.
options.zh: 這可能是社會習得的觀念在影響她；我們讓小組更友善，讓她自行決定吧。

options.en: She must never have liked fixing toys if she stopped coming.
options.zh: 如果她不再來，她一定從未喜歡修玩具。

options.en: Those comments cannot matter unless the school has an official rule.
options.zh: 除非學校有正式規定，否則那些說法不可能有影響。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友描述反覆的性別期待與退縮，應承認可能影響並保留孩子自主選擇；其餘回應忽略已知興趣或非正式壓力。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她很喜歡修理玩具，但同學一直說女孩子不該碰工具，現在她不敢參加小組。」你怎樣回應最貼切？

speaking.en: Social conditioning can affect the activities students feel free to try, even when no rule forbids them.
speaking.zh: 即使沒有禁令，社會習得的觀念仍可能影響學生覺得自己可以嘗試哪些活動。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出學生從哪裏學到活動是否適合自己的觀念。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：幾位長者想學用智能手機，但多年來聽到「科技只適合年輕人」，因而不敢報名。導師鼓勵任何有興趣的人參加，並讓學員自行決定。用一至兩句英文解釋他們猶豫的可能原因和導師的做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出長者原本想學、長期聽到的年齡期待可能令他們猶豫，以及導師鼓勵他們自行決定；不要說年齡必然阻止學習。

examples.en: Social conditioning may make older adults who want to learn smartphone skills hesitate to join; the tutor welcomes anyone interested and leaves the choice to them.
examples.zh: 社會習得的觀念可能令想學智能手機操作的長者猶豫是否參加；導師歡迎所有有興趣的人，讓他們自行決定。

examples.en: The repeated claim that technology is only for young people is a form of social conditioning; the tutor encourages willing older learners to try the class and choose for themselves.
examples.zh: 「科技只適合年輕人」這種反覆出現的說法是一種社會習得的觀念；導師鼓勵有意學習的長者嘗試課堂並自行選擇。

takeaways.en: Social conditioning may narrow what children believe they are allowed to enjoy.
takeaways.zh: 社會習得的觀念可能限制孩子認為自己可以喜歡甚麼。

takeaways.en: Questioning social conditioning can help a student make a freer choice.
takeaways.zh: 質疑社會習得的觀念，有助學生更自由地作選擇。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Remain able to compete or participate rather than being pushed out.
brief.meaningZh: 保持參與或競爭的能力，不致被淘汰或退出。
brief.grammar: Training helps small firms stay in the game.
brief.register: Sports metaphor in business and other competitive settings; identify the field and the pressure.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課重點是仍有資格或能力參與競爭；比 stay the course 更着重能否留在競爭之中，而非只堅持原計劃。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把暫時仍在場內說成已勝出，也不要把任何堅持都當成有競爭力。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出一項新做法如何幫助參與者在競爭中繼續立足。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 29, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Small firms need training to stay in the game.

listening.en: A neighbourhood bookshop could not match the chains’ advertising budget. It trained staff to take online orders, helping the shop stay in the game without claiming it would outsell the chains.
listening.zh: 社區書店無法與連鎖店的廣告預算相比，便培訓職員接受網上訂單，幫助書店保持競爭力，但並不表示一定能賣得比連鎖店多。
listening.promptZh: stay in the game 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The shop remains able to compete by adding a needed service.
options.zh: 書店增設顧客需要的服務，仍能參與競爭。

options.en: The shop is certain to become the market leader next month.
options.zh: 書店下個月一定會成為市場龍頭。

options.en: The shop keeps its old method without responding to competitors.
options.zh: 書店不理會競爭者，繼續沿用舊方法。

options.en: The training merely kept the shop’s old service unchanged as customer habits shifted.
options.zh: 顧客習慣改變之際，培訓只是令書店原有服務維持不變。

listening.explanationZh: 網上下單令小店仍可參與市場競爭，不表示必然勝出；也不是單純沿用舊方法或字面運動。

reply.promptEn: Why should the local repair shop offer online booking when larger chains already do?
reply.promptZh: （大型連鎖店已有網上預約，為何本地維修店也應提供？）

options.en: Customers could choose the local shop without having to call during work hours.
options.zh: 顧客無須在上班時間打電話，也能選擇本地店舖。

options.en: The new option would help the shop compete for busy customers.
options.zh: 新選項有助店舖爭取忙碌的顧客。

options.en: Online booking could help the small shop stay in the game.
options.zh: 網上預約可幫助小店保持競爭資格。

options.en: People who prefer web forms could still use its repair service.
options.zh: 偏好網上表格的人仍可使用這家店的維修服務。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出網上預約如何有助小店繼續爭取顧客；金句用競爭比喻總結。

options.en: The cinema adapted its offer to stay in the game.
options.zh: 戲院調整服務以保持競爭力。

options.en: The cinema is guaranteed to lead the whole film market now.
options.zh: 戲院現時必然能領先整個電影市場。

options.en: The cinema merely kept its old schedule despite losing viewers.
options.zh: 戲院流失觀眾後仍只沿用舊放映時間表。

scene.explanationZh: 戲院調整服務以保留觀眾，符合仍能參與競爭；並無證據保證成為市場龍頭。
scene.promptZh: 小型戲院因大型串流平台競爭而失去部分觀眾，於是推出映後討論及社區場次，仍能吸引固定觀眾群。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A small café learns online ordering to keep serving changing customer needs.
options.zh: 小咖啡店學會網上下單，繼續滿足變化中的顧客需要。

options.en: A shop permanently closes and stops offering its product to customers.
options.zh: 店舖永久結業，不再向顧客提供產品。

options.en: A local team recruits enough players to remain in next season’s league.
options.zh: 本地球隊招募足夠球員，繼續參加下季聯賽。

contrast.explanationZh: 永久結業後不再參與市場，不能說仍在競爭中；其他兩項保留參與能力。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 stay in the game 表示保持競爭資格？

options.en: That could help us stay in the game by making pickup easier for busy customers.
options.zh: 這可讓忙碌顧客更易自取餐點，幫我們保持競爭力。

options.en: Because we have a new idea, we will certainly beat every chain by next week.
options.zh: 有了新構思，下星期我們一定能勝過所有連鎖店。

options.en: There is no need to offer pickup if customers are already leaving.
options.zh: 顧客正流失，所以毋須提供自取服務。

dialogue.explanationZh: 網上預訂可回應顧客需要，幫助小店繼續競爭；不等於保證勝過所有對手。
dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「小咖啡店正流失外帶顧客，但我們可以開始網上預訂自取。」你如何回應最貼切？

speaking.en: Local bakeries can stay in the game by offering a service their customers value.
speaking.zh: 本地麵包店若提供顧客重視的服務，便能保持競爭力。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明小店如何繼續參與競爭。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一間獨立社區電台的聽眾被大型串流平台吸走。電台推出居民電話討論節目和網上重溫服務，讓本地聽眾有理由回來。用一至兩句英文描述電台如何繼續競爭。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出大型平台帶來競爭、電台增設居民電話節目和網上重溫，以及新做法有助留住本地聽眾；不要保證電台一定勝過平台。

examples.en: To stay in the game against large streaming platforms, the local station added community call-in shows and online replays that gave nearby listeners a reason to return.
examples.zh: 為了與大型串流平台競爭，本地電台增設社區電話討論節目和網上重溫，令附近聽眾有理由回來。

examples.en: The independent radio station stayed in the game by offering local call-in programmes and web replays, helping it keep an audience despite streaming competition.
examples.zh: 儘管面對串流平台競爭，獨立電台藉着提供本地電話討論節目及網上重溫，保持競爭力並留住聽眾。

takeaways.en: A small grocer stayed in the game by adding a reliable delivery option.
takeaways.zh: 小雜貨店增設可靠送貨服務，得以保持競爭力。

takeaways.en: Training can help workers stay in the game when industry skills change.
takeaways.zh: 當行業技能改變時，培訓可幫助員工維持競爭力。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Be overwhelmed by more forms and documents than one can handle comfortably.
brief.meaningZh: 面對大量表格和文件，忙得應付不來。
brief.grammar: The staff were drowning in paperwork before the system changed.
brief.register: Vivid workload metaphor; it concerns document burden, not literal water or a single simple form.
brief.boundaryZh: 與 buried in homework 同屬工作量過重的比喻，但本課特指文書、表格和紀錄，不是學生功課。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只因桌面有紙就用 drowning；關鍵是文件量多到阻礙正常工作。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪些重複文書堆積，以及工作因此受甚麼影響。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 30, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The staff were drowning in paperwork before the system changed.

listening.en: The clinic staff had to copy each patient detail onto three separate forms, and simple requests were taking days. They were drowning in paperwork until the forms were combined.
listening.zh: 診所職員須把每位病人的資料抄到三份不同表格，簡單申請也要數天處理。表格合併之前，他們一直被文書工作淹沒。
listening.promptZh: 為甚麼說職員 were drowning in paperwork？

options.en: Repeated forms overwhelmed them and delayed ordinary requests.
options.zh: 重複表格令他們忙得應付不來，耽誤日常申請。

options.en: A single new form gave them useful information without adding work.
options.zh: 一份新表格提供有用資料，沒有增加工作。

options.en: They chose to review patient records carefully, so each request took longer.
options.zh: 他們選擇仔細核對病歷，所以每項申請較慢。

options.en: The delay came from optional research the staff chose to do, rather than from the required forms.
options.zh: 延誤源於職員自行選擇的額外資料搜集，而非必須填寫的表格。

listening.explanationZh: 大量重複表格已拖慢普通申請，顯示文書負擔過重；不是單一表格或字面漏水。

reply.promptEn: Why are the shelter volunteers behind on simple animal-care requests?
reply.promptZh: （收容所義工為何連簡單的動物照料申請也處理不及？）

options.en: They have to enter the same details on several forms.
options.zh: 他們要在幾份表格上重複輸入相同資料。

options.en: The pile of records leaves little time for the requests themselves.
options.zh: 大量紀錄令他們沒有多少時間處理申請本身。

options.en: They are drowning in paperwork from repeated intake forms.
options.zh: 他們被重複的收容登記表格淹沒。

options.en: They spend so long checking duplicate documents that requests wait.
options.zh: 他們花太多時間核對重複文件，令申請久候。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋重複文書如何令照料申請延後；金句用被文件淹沒的比喻概括。

options.en: They are drowning in paperwork, so other work is being delayed.
options.zh: 他們被文書工作淹沒，其他工作因而延誤。

options.en: They have a few forms but enough time to answer every call promptly.
options.zh: 他們雖有幾份表格，仍有足夠時間即時回覆每通電話。

options.en: The problem comes from a telephone fault rather than their document workload.
options.zh: 問題來自電話故障，而非文書負擔。

scene.explanationZh: 五份重複表格已拖慢電話回覆，表明文件量妨礙正常工作；沒有電話故障的證據。
scene.promptZh: 社區中心職員每天須把同一資料填進五份紙本表格，結果電話查詢久久未能回覆。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Workers cannot reach urgent cases because they must complete stacks of duplicate forms.
options.zh: 職員要填寫大量重複表格，無法及時處理緊急個案。

options.en: A receptionist fills out one short form and has time for every visitor.
options.zh: 接待員只填一份簡短表格，仍能照顧每位訪客。

options.en: Teachers spend evenings repeating records and struggle to plan lessons.
options.zh: 老師晚上要重複填寫紀錄，難以備課。

contrast.explanationZh: 一份簡短表格未造成應付不來的負擔；另兩項都顯示文書量妨礙其他工作。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 drowning in paperwork？

options.en: We are drowning in paperwork; perhaps one shared form could reduce the repeated entries.
options.zh: 我們被文書工作淹沒；或許一份共用表格可減少重複輸入。

options.en: The forms must be helpful because there are more of them.
options.zh: 表格較多，所以它們一定較有幫助。

options.en: We should focus only on the number of sheets, not whether cases are delayed.
options.zh: 我們只應看紙張數量，不用理會個案有否延誤。

dialogue.explanationZh: 同事說重複輸入已妨礙處理個案，回應應認出文書負擔並提出減少重複；另兩項忽略後果。
dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我今天又要把同一批資料填三次，重要個案一直處理不及。」你怎樣回應最貼切？

speaking.en: The team was drowning in paperwork before it replaced three forms with one shared record.
speaking.zh: 團隊把三份表格合為一份共用紀錄前，一直被文書工作淹沒。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪些文件造成負擔。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校辦公室為每名新生填三份內容重複的表格，結果家長查詢遲遲未獲回覆。團隊改用一份共用電子登記表。用一至兩句英文描述問題及改善。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出每名新生的三份重複表格拖慢回覆家長，以及共用電子登記表如何減少文書負擔；不要說真的被水淹。

examples.en: The school office was drowning in paperwork because each new pupil needed three duplicate forms; one shared digital form helped staff answer parents sooner.
examples.zh: 每名新生都要填三份重複表格，令學校辦公室被文書工作淹沒；一份共用電子表格幫助職員更快回覆家長。

examples.en: Parents waited for replies while staff were drowning in paperwork, so the office replaced three repeated enrolment forms with a single shared record.
examples.zh: 職員被文書工作淹沒，家長因而久候回覆；辦公室遂以一份共用紀錄取代三份重複的入學表格。

takeaways.en: The office was drowning in paperwork before it simplified its application process.
takeaways.zh: 辦公室簡化申請程序前，一直被文書工作淹沒。

takeaways.en: When forms repeat the same questions, a small team can quickly drown in paperwork.
takeaways.zh: 表格若反覆問相同問題，小團隊很快便可能被文書工作淹沒。

lessons.titleZh: 在原有壓力上再加一層

brief.meaningEn: Add a new burden to an already demanding situation.
brief.meaningZh: 在本已有壓力的情況下再增加負擔。
brief.grammar: The extra reporting rule piles on pressure during exams.
brief.register: Natural figurative pattern; identify both the existing pressure and the added demand.
brief.boundaryZh: 與 under intense pressure 不同：那描述已有壓力；本課必須有新要求再加上去。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把任何普通工作都說成 piles on pressure；要有原先負擔及新增要求。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原有壓力、新增要求，以及它如何令情況更難應付。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 30, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The extra reporting rule piles on pressure during exams.

listening.en: The actors were already rehearsing late for opening night. A new daily report was then required from each of them, and the extra task piled on pressure during the final week.
listening.zh: 演員為首演夜已排練到很晚，之後又被要求每人每天提交報告。新增工作在最後一週令壓力更重。

options.en: A new report was added while the actors were already busy rehearsing.
options.zh: 演員本已忙於排練，又多了每天提交報告的要求。

options.en: The actors received more time to rehearse and no new task.
options.zh: 演員多了排練時間，沒有新增工作。

options.en: The daily report replaced rehearsals, leaving the total workload unchanged.
options.zh: 每日日報取代排練，總工作量沒有增加。

options.en: Opening night had been cancelled before the report was introduced.
options.zh: 新增日報前，首演夜已取消。

listening.explanationZh: 原本已排練到很晚，新增日報再添負擔；單純已有壓力或工作被替代都不足以表達 piles on pressure。

reply.promptEn: What did the surprise extra rehearsal do when the cast was already preparing for opening night?
reply.promptZh: （演員本已為首演夜忙於準備，突然增加一次排練有甚麼影響？）

options.en: It gave the cast another demand during an already busy week.
options.zh: 它在忙碌的一週裏再給演員增加一項要求。

options.en: It made their existing preparation feel more demanding.
options.zh: 它令原有準備工作更吃力。

options.en: It piled on pressure while they were already working late.
options.zh: 他們本已工作至深夜，它令壓力再增加。

options.en: It left them with less time to finish their other preparation.
options.zh: 它令他們完成其他準備工作的時間更少。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理說明新排練如何增加原有負擔；金句明確說在既有壓力上再加一層。

options.en: The new reporting demand piles on pressure when the volunteers are already stretched.
options.zh: 義工本已吃緊，新增匯報要求令壓力更大。

options.en: The detailed record replaces every other duty, so no extra burden remains.
options.zh: 詳細紀錄取代所有其他工作，因此沒有新增負擔。

options.en: The volunteers feel pressure only because the festival is unfamiliar.
options.zh: 義工有壓力，只因節日活動對他們陌生。

scene.explanationZh: 人手不足是原有壓力，每天詳盡匯報是新增要求；其餘說法抹去了新增負擔。
scene.promptZh: 義工已因人手不足而趕着籌備節日活動，此時主辦方又要求每天提交詳盡紀錄。哪句最貼切？

options.en: A second deadline is added while staff are struggling to meet the first.
options.zh: 職員趕第一個期限時，又加了第二個期限。

options.en: A deadline is extended and one unnecessary report is removed.
options.zh: 期限延長，而且一份不必要的報告被取消。

options.en: An extra inspection is scheduled when a team is already short-staffed.
options.zh: 團隊本已人手不足，又要應付額外檢查。

contrast.explanationZh: 延長期限並刪去報告減少負擔；另兩項是在原有壓力上新增要求。
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 piles on pressure？

options.en: That piles on pressure; could we agree which task needs to be done first?
options.zh: 那令壓力更大；我們可否先商定哪項工作優先？

options.en: If the new form matters, it cannot add any pressure to an already busy day.
options.zh: 如果新表格重要，就不可能令忙碌的一天更有壓力。

options.en: The deadline will feel easier if we ignore the extra form without telling anyone.
options.zh: 如果不告訴任何人就不理新表格，期限便會較輕鬆。

dialogue.explanationZh: 原有交貨期限已緊，新表格再添工作；回應可承認新增壓力並協商優先次序。
dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們本已忙着趕交貨，經理又要我們今晚改用新表格重填資料。」你怎樣回應較貼切？

speaking.en: Adding another report piles on pressure when the small team is already working late.
speaking.zh: 小團隊本已工作至深夜，再加一份報告令壓力更大。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出原有負擔與新增要求。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小麵包店人手不足，仍在趕製週末訂單。經理此時新增每日詳細庫存報告，職員請求改用較簡短的紀錄表。用一至兩句英文描述增加的壓力和可行做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出原有人手不足和週末訂單、新增每日庫存報告，以及請求簡化紀錄；不要只說大家本來有壓力。

examples.en: The bakery was already short-staffed while filling weekend orders, and a new daily stock report piled on pressure; the staff requested a simpler record sheet.
examples.zh: 麵包店本已人手不足，忙着完成週末訂單；新增每日庫存報告令壓力更大，職員因此請求使用較簡短的紀錄表。

examples.en: A detailed stock report every day piles on pressure while the small bakery prepares weekend orders with too few staff, so the team asked for a shorter form.
examples.zh: 小麵包店人手不足，忙於週末訂單時，每日詳細庫存報告令壓力再增加；團隊因此要求使用較短的表格。

glossary.en: A detailed stock report every day

takeaways.en: A new fee can pile on pressure for families already facing high rents.
takeaways.zh: 對本已面對高租金的家庭而言，新增收費可令壓力再增加。

takeaways.en: Replacing duplicate forms with one form does not pile on pressure; it removes work.
takeaways.zh: 以一份表格取代重複表格不會增加壓力，而是減少工作。
